report.explanation: Alert shows checkout durations of 344, 62, 63, 78 ms with all 200s. Traces and logs show successful checkout/order/payment/inventory calls; metrics show checkout p95 425 ms but zero 502s and no dependency errors. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause among the taxonomy; the single 344 ms sample is insufficient to claim downstream latency.
missing_evidence: Baseline checkout latency distribution to judge whether 344 ms is anomalous
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, payment, inventory, redis, postgres
Error or timeout logs from downstream services during the window
Deployment or config change records correlated with the window
